args:
set -eu
cp -r /web/build/. /work/web/
# Source maps are not needed by the production UI and may embed
# development-only source imports such as Google Fonts. Do not serve
# them from the production asset volume.
find /work/web/static -type f -name '*.map' -delete
if [ -f /work/web/index.html ]; then
  sed -i -e 's#<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="https://cdn.casbin.org[^"]*"/>##g' \
    -e 's#<link rel="manifest" href="https://cdn.casbin.org[^"]*"/>##g' \
    /work/web/index.html
fi
# Casdoor's compiled bundle uses a remote favicon URL in the default
# document head and MFA QR view. Replace it with a tiny data URI so the
# provider UI has no runtime dependency on cdn.casdoor.com.
for js in /work/web/static/js/*.js; do
  [ -f "$js" ] || continue
  sed -i 's#https://cdn\.casdoor\.com/static/favicon\.png#data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///ywAAAAAAQABAAACAUwAOw==#g' "$js"
done
for css in /work/web/static/css/*.css; do
  [ -f "$css" ] || continue
  sed -E -i 's#@import url\(https://fonts\.googleapis\.com[^)]*\);##g' "$css"
done
test -s /work/web/index.html
js_found=false
for js in /work/web/static/js/*.js; do
  if [ -s "$js" ]; then js_found=true; break; fi
done
test "$js_found" = true
initContainers.name: prepare-web-assets
